series.title: Rangeland Management
series.statusStatement: Active (EMST OPM series register, as of 2026-10-23).
series.qualificationStandardVersion: Professional & Scientific Positions group std + series IOR
series.educationNote: FH judgment pending verification of the qualification standard

generalCompetencies: not mapped in this release (X9 USA Hire and FWCI parts not built; WP-09 open item 6)

roles.functionStatement: Keep shared rangelands productive and resilient through monitored, authorized and adapted grazing use.

instruments.label: Federal land special-use and grazing authorizations

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Monitor rangeland condition with calibrated field indicators

tasks.statement: Measure line-point intercept, canopy gap and soil stability on rangeland monitoring plots following the core-indicator protocol
Complete a qualitative rangeland health assessment against the ecological site's reference sheet
Calibrate cover and gap measurements with other observers until results agree within the protocol's tolerance
Compare remote-sensing cover estimates with plot data, flagging areas where the product misrepresents observed conditions

majorDuties.duty: Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols

tasks.statement: Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives
Relocate permanent plot monuments from recorded bearings and coordinates, re-establishing lost markers so repeat measurements stay comparable
Identify plants on sample plots to the protocol's required taxonomic level, collecting labelled vouchers for any plant not identified with certainty

majorDuties.duty: Describe, test and sample soils in the field

tasks.statement: Classify soil horizons and profiles in the field to the applicable national soil classification system, documenting diagnostic features for each horizon
Describe a soil profile's horizons, colour, texture, structure and coarse fragments in standard terminology on the program's description form
Collect soil samples at specified depths and locations for laboratory analysis of texture, nutrients, carbon or contaminants

majorDuties.duty: Issue environmental permits and resource-use authorizations as the deciding authority

tasks.statement: Review a permit application for administrative and technical completeness, issuing a deficiency notice that lists each missing element and its basis
Derive permit limits and conditions from the applicable technical standards and the facility's technical record, documenting the calculation basis for each limit
Draft a permit and its fact sheet so that each condition is measurable, enforceable and traceable to its legal or technical basis

majorDuties.duty: Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land

tasks.statement: Adjust field plans on a landowner's property to their access conditions, livestock, crops or concerns raised on the day, recording the change
Explain field findings and their limits face to face to landowners or community members on site, answering questions about methods and uncertainty
Conduct a joint field visit with a landowner or permittee, walking the site together and recording both parties' observations

majorDuties.duty: Plan, authorize and monitor livestock grazing on shared rangelands

tasks.statement: Monitor utilization, stubble height and streambank alteration on key areas against allotment objectives during the grazing season
Adjust a grazing permit's terms and conditions from monitoring results, documenting the basis for each change

majorDuties.duty: Detect, treat and monitor invasive species in the field

tasks.statement: Treat invasive plants by mechanical, chemical or biological methods to the treatment prescription, protecting non-target vegetation and water
Select a control method for an infestation within integrated pest management, weighing efficacy, non-target risk, timing and follow-up capacity

majorDuties.duty: Conduct environmental impact review of proposed actions

tasks.statement: Prepare an environmental assessment of a proposed action, analyzing the reasonably foreseeable effects of the action and its alternatives within the procedure's page and time limits
Scope the review of a proposed action with cooperating agencies and the public, setting the purpose, alternatives and effects boundaries the analysis will cover

majorDuties.duty: Prepare and revise management plans for publicly held lands

tasks.statement: Coordinate an interdisciplinary team drafting a forest, range or refuge management plan, assigning plan components and reconciling conflicting resource objectives
Follow the agency's planning procedure and schedule for a plan revision or amendment, documenting each required step and its completion

majorDuties.duty: Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings

tasks.statement: Identify regional plants and animals to species with dichotomous keys and diagnostic features, collecting evidence for any record not identified with certainty
Verify species records submitted by crews or volunteers against attached photos, recordings or vouchers before they enter the program database
